name: ChordRes with learned token velocity and saved forces
tagline: A learned initial tangent velocity for each token type.
description: A vocabulary lookup is projected onto the tangent space of the initial hidden state. The remaining scalar Chord updates use the same 23-layer, saved-force model as the zero-velocity control.
mechanism: Independent BF16 token velocity embedding projected onto the initial hidden tangent space
Independent scalar controls for each attention and FFN site
BF16 force tensors retained on the GPU for the fused Chord backward
limitations: Uses the shared zero-initialized output projections and reference optimizer. The full leaderboard result requires the 46,875-update endpoint.
